scope: Additive primary-source level table for Royal Gem wielder HP and DPS bonuses. It changes the evidence tier of existing catalogue values, not combat behavior.
game_version: Supercell 2025-01-22 announcement for the February 2025 update; September 2026 secondary page claims client build 18.600.3 and displays the same bonuses. Exact current executable and effect ordering are unverified.

sources.title: 英雄裝備平衡性調整！ (Hero Equipment Balance Changes!)
facts: The official Traditional Chinese page explicitly prints before-and-after Royal Gem DPS and HP increase for every level 1-18; the English version of the same announcement omits the tables.
Its post-buff HP sequence is 60-570 and DPS sequence is 35-120, matching all 18 retained catalogue rows.
sources.limitations: This is an announced February 2025 balance table. It does not define when a bonus enters the battle, whether and how both equipped items' bonuses stack, maximum/current HP conversion, damage-per-hit rounding, or the active heal event.

sources.title: Royal Gem — Clash of Clans Wiki
facts: The page reports client build 18.600.3 and displays the same 18 HP/DPS bonus pairs as Supercell's post-buff table.
sources.limitations: The site is secondary and does not publish the current active heal amounts or deterministic stat application order.

derivations.result: All 18 retained HP and DPS bonus pairs have direct Supercell numeric corroboration and a dated September 2026 secondary match.
derivations.method: Transcribe only the post-buff columns from the official Traditional Chinese table, compare level by level to the immutable normalized catalogue and to the claimed 18.600.3 page; do not transfer the heal or event semantics.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply the bonus at deployment with both current and maximum HP increased
rejected_inferences.reason: The official table gives the bonus amount, not the deployment phase or maximum/current HP conversion.

rejected_inferences.rule: Add the listed DPS directly to each attack's damage per hit
rejected_inferences.reason: DPS is not damage per hit; cadence, rounding and interactions with Haste Vial or other Equipment are not defined here.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat the post-buff HP/DPS table as proof that the historical active healthRecovery series is current
rejected_inferences.reason: The official table has no active-heal column and the dated secondary table omits active heal values.

items: precise equipped-bonus application phase and maximum/current HP conversion
DPS-to-hit conversion, rounding and interaction with attack-speed modifiers
current active heal values, activation command and same-tick heal/damage/death ordering
snapshot and replay of any future-influencing Equipment state

conclusion: Royal Gem HP and DPS bonus values for all 18 levels now have direct primary numeric evidence, with the retained rows corroborated by a September 2026 reported build. Combat application remains partial because the deterministic deployment, stacking and active-heal contracts are still missing.
